sources.title: Cruzer (by Crafter) EF-OD Over Drive | Effects Database
sources.excerpt: Effects Database has an exact record for the Cruzer (by Crafter) EF-OD Over Drive from the 2009 NAMM period. The description says the pedal uses a rugged steel case and analog circuitry with modern components to produce classic valve-style overdrive tones. It also specifies buffered bypass intended to preserve clean guitar tone and allow silent switching between effect and bypass. The record links the model to Crafter documentation and related products.
